notes.title: QUICK UPDATE - WE'RE GETTING THERE - MUSIC IS PRETTY COOL
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Hey everyone! [/b][/u][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34426734/5e9968e6ffbb361ba6ff71130dfc99ce1b0de8c4.png[/img]
Here's a quick update because we've been super quiet lately:

[list]
[*]  The game is coming along real nicely! Right now, we're fixing bugs, adding sound effects and polishing dialogue. We're well on time though.
[*]  Our composer has finished about 60% of the soundtrack so far, and we're super excited about how it's turning out. We can't wait for you guys to hear it.
[*] To all our Indiegogo backers: Most of your rewards, such as items and portraits, are in the game already!
[/list]

That's all from me for now. Gonna go back to doing important dev stuff.

See you guys later!

Clam Man & Team Clam
